# Retained Vector Owner Fixtures

Fixed synthetic `2.0.0/full-v1` archives generated from the pinned historical
server fixture by the clean-installed Core verifier. `capture.json` binds the
input, five replacement variants, package and verifier. These are not a new
live-server capture, published authority tuple or released compatibility claim.

`input.shard` contains one retained vector and a second declared set. Replacement
variants change its note, clear its note, change its set, clear its set, or leave
both unchanged. The same bytes are exercised by installed Core and the producer
native-import regression. Tokens and virtual materialization state are seeded
natively at each destination, not invented as new portable fields.

Assertions preserve independent note ownership, retained identities and payloads;
invalid optional native pointers detach and affected referenced-vector caches
become stale. Repeat and late rollback are required. Publication, consumer pins,
complete cache invalidation, native writers and released/platform matrices remain
open. Suite NO-GO remains.
